criteria.name: Neural Network Design & Implementation
criteria.guidance: Implement an appropriate neural network for the defined loan default prediction task with documented architecture.

criteria.name: Data Preparation & Training
criteria.guidance: Apply appropriate encoding/scaling, training-validation split and leakage prevention; document training choices.

criteria.name: Model Evaluation & Overfitting Analysis
criteria.guidance: Evaluate on held-out data, compare train/validation performance and discuss overfitting and class-sensitive errors.

criteria.name: ML vs DL Comparison
criteria.guidance: Compare the neural network against a selected ML model on the same holdout using consistent metrics.

criteria.name: NLP Implementation & Findings
criteria.guidance: Implement a defined NLP task relevant to the project materials; show evidence and valid evaluation without inventing labels or metrics.
